meta.name: ponytail-review
meta.description: Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering. Finds what to delete: reinvented standard library, unneeded dependencies, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility. One line per finding: location, what to cut, what replaces it. Use when the user says "review for over-engineering", "what can we delete", "is this over-engineered", "simplify review", or invokes /ponytail-review. Complements correctness-focused review, this one only hunts complexity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码中过度设计，找出可删除的部分
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望消除代码中不必要的复杂性和过度工程
copy.tagline_en: Review code for over-engineering, find what to delete
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to eliminate unnecessary complexity and over-engineering in your code

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在代码审查时只关注过度工程化,输出逐条清单:每行指出位置、要删除的内容和替代方案。它专挑手写标准库已有函数、多余依赖、无用抽象等,最后给出能减少的总行数。
howto.when: 当用户说“review for over-engineering”、“what can we delete”或“simplify review”等,或调用 /ponytail-review 时触发。只处理复杂性问题,不处理正确性、安全和性能。

say.text: What can we delete? 看看这个 PR 有没有过度抽象。
say.note: 只查复杂性问题,不查正确性。

say.text: 这个文件是不是 over-engineered? 帮我简化一下。
say.note: 会给出具体删除建议和替代方案。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude reviews code solely for over-engineering and outputs a line-by-line list: each finding shows location, what to delete, and a replacement. It targets reimplemented stdlib, unneeded deps, useless abstractions, etc., ending with the total lines saved.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "review for over-engineering", "what can we delete", or "simplify review", etc., or invokes /ponytail-review. Only handles complexity, not correctness, security, or performance.

say_en.text: Review for over-engineering: what can be deleted here?
say_en.note: Claude lists removable deps and hand-rolled functions.

say_en.text: What can we delete? Check this PR for over-abstraction.
say_en.note: Only complexity, not correctness, is checked.

say_en.text: Is this file over-engineered? Simplify it for me.
